summary.intent: Review and resolve open PR review threads on cipher-box PR #507, including an out-of-diff-range comment about atomicity ordering in the SDK's moveItem function.
summary.outcome: All PR threads resolved: spawnSync timeout fix committed, an out-of-diff-range CodeRabbit comment about unsafe re-encryption ordering in the SDK client was identified as valid and fixed by reordering operations to publish-dest-before-re-encrypt, with tests updated and lint passing.

repo: cipher-box uses a .planning/todos/pending/ directory for tracking deferred technical debt as markdown files
cipherbox-core is an internal path-dependency crate (unpublished), so semver minor-vs-patch is cosmetic for it
The project uses release-please for bot-managed versioning with release-as config
PR #507 introduced moveItem re-encryption logic in the SDK client

code.finding: The safer atomicity ordering for moveItem is: publish-dest → re-encrypt → publish-source (add-before-remove). The original order (re-encrypt → publish-dest → publish-source) could leave data unreadable everywhere if dest publish failed after re-encryption.
Failure-path tests pin operation ordering; when the underlying code ordering changes, tests must be rewritten to match the new (safer) sequence, not just updated for renamed variables.
spawnSync calls need explicit timeout (60_000) and maxBuffer options, plus result.error handling, to prevent stalled processes from hanging the E2E suite.
There is an acknowledged atomicity window in the desktop/FUSE re-encryption path that is harder to fix than the SDK side; deferred by design with a pinned todo.

workflow: GitHub out-of-diff-range comments are easy to miss in normal PR review flows but can contain valid, actionable feedback — worth fetching review bodies directly via API
CodeRabbit suggestions should be evaluated on technical merit even when marked out-of-diff-range; the suggestion here (operation reorder) was genuinely safer
Always run tsc + test suite after reordering operations that have behavior-pinning tests, before committing

friction: Out-of-diff-range GitHub comments are not surfaced by default tooling, requiring the user to manually flag the review URL
The initial resolve-pr-reviews pass missed a valid applicable comment, requiring a correction loop
open_items: restoreFromBin re-encryption atomicity gap remains unaddressed (deferred, tracked in .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-17-move-restore-reencrypt-partial-failure-recovery.md)
Desktop/FUSE re-encryption atomicity window (crates/fuse/src/lib.rs:718-764) is deferred by design — full idempotency/recovery not yet implemented
Full idempotency and crash-recovery for moveItem across all paths (SDK + desktop + restoreFromBin) is a follow-up todo
